name: Sycsense
name_zh: 赛感科技（深圳）有限公司
summary: Sycsense is a Shenzhen-based developer and manufacturer of flexible tactile sensors, electronic skin and sensor acquisition electronics. Founded in June 2023, the company commercializes technology originating from the Southern University of Science and Technology flexible electronics laboratory. Its products support tactile research, industrial grippers, dexterous robot hands and humanoid body sensing, alongside consumer, automotive and healthcare applications. The portfolio includes single-point and array pressure sensors, data collection modules and integrated tactile sensing systems.
